lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: JAMAL STOP! [beat] ONE TINY SPARK AND THIS ENTIRE HOUSE GOES UP IN FLAMES WITH ALL OF US TRAPPED INSIDE!

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: I don't care about the house anymore [beat] you all kept the inheritance from me for years while I played the happy uncle!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Uncle Jamal, look at the floor [beat] the old insulation is literally soaked in kerosene from that leaked heater!

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: He’s lost his mind Rafiq [beat] he’d rather see us burn than let us have a single penny of my father’s legacy!

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: Legacy? [beat] This isn't a legacy, it’s a curse that turned me into a beggar while you lived in luxury!

lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: I'm calling the police right now [beat] if you don't drop that lighter I swear you'll never see the sun again!

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: Go ahead and call them [beat] by the time they get through this traffic, we'll all be nothing but headlines and ash!

lines.speaker: milli
lines.text: Uncle Jamal please [beat] you used to buy me ice cream every Sunday, you aren't a bad person, just put it down!

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: Don't talk to her like that [beat] step away from my daughter or I will forget that we share the same blood!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Wait, what is that sound [beat] the attic floorboards are creaking under the weight of the safe, it’s about to give way!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The tension in the air was thicker than the smoke [beat] as Jamal’s thumb began to press down on the ignition.

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: If I can't have the secret hidden in this safe [beat] then nobody in this family gets to keep their lives today!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: THE FLOOR IS COLLAPSING [beat] JAMAL WATCH OUT BEHIND YOU BEFORE THE WHOLE ROOF COMES DOWN ON TOP OF US!
